summary: Nintendo's sci-fi animal-pilot rail-shooter series, covering the SNES originals, Star Fox 64 and its remakes/reimaginings, GameCube action entries, DS/Wii U experiments, Guard, and the upcoming Switch 2 remake.

entries.title: Star Fox
entries.definitive_edition: Official emulated SNES release via Super NES Classic Edition / Nintendo Classics

emulation.emulator: Official Nintendo Classics / Super NES Classic; bsnes or snes9x for owned-copy preservation
emulation.notes: Use official Nintendo routes where available; use SNES emulation only for owned-copy preservation/comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original SNES presentation through accurate emulation

primary.platform: Nintendo Classics / Super NES Classic Edition
primary.why: The original Star Fox is an SNES rail shooter using the Super FX chip. Official modern emulation through Super NES Classic Edition or Nintendo Classics is the cleanest accessible route while preserving the original release.
primary.how_to_play: Play the official Nintendo Classics/Super NES Classic Edition release, or use original SNES hardware if preserving cartridge behavior matters.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Super FX cartridge release, called Starwing in PAL regions.
all_releases.reason: skip: historically original, but official modern emulation is the more accessible route with no content loss.

all_releases.fidelity: Official emulated SNES release bundled on Super NES Classic Edition.
all_releases.reason: primary: official accessible route preserving the original game.
skip: equivalent official emulated route; no sourced content advantage over Super NES Classic Edition.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Official emulated releases preserve the original game; no platform-exclusive content requires a secondary route.

entries.remaster_caveats: The 2026 Star Fox entry is a separate future remake/reboot entry and does not replace this original SNES entry.

entries.title: Star Fox 64

emulation.emulator: Lime3DS / Citra-derived emulator; ares/simple64 for N64
emulation.notes: Use 3DS hardware/emulation for the primary; N64 emulation for original comparison.

primary.why: Star Fox 64 3D is the released remake with updated graphics, stereoscopic 3D, quality-of-life changes, gyro controls, and new voice recordings, making it the best current released version of Star Fox 64 until the future Switch 2 remake ships.
primary.how_to_play: Play Star Fox 64 3D on Nintendo 3DS hardware or a legally dumped copy in 3DS emulation.

secondary.what_to_play: Use it to compare the original N64 release and rumble-era presentation.
secondary.why: The 3DS remake is the fidelity primary, while NSO preserves the original version.

all_releases.fidelity: Original N64 release, known as Lylat Wars in PAL regions.
all_releases.reason: skip: historically original, but superseded visually by the 3DS remake.

all_releases.platform: Wii / Wii U Virtual Console / Nintendo Switch Online Expansion Pack
all_releases.reason: secondary: preserves original version, but lower fidelity than 3DS remake.

all_releases.fidelity: Remake with updated graphics, stereoscopic 3D, gyro controls, and new voice recordings.
all_releases.reason: primary: best current released version of Star Fox 64.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: 3DS remake is visually enhanced; Nintendo Switch Online preserves the exact N64 original.

entries.remaster_caveats: A Switch 2 remake is announced for June 25, 2026 but is not available on the current archive date, June 18, 2026.

emulation.notes: Dolphin can raise internal resolution and improve output quality.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: GameCube emulation at high internal resolution

primary.why: Star Fox Adventures is a GameCube-exclusive action-adventure entry with no port or remaster; Dolphin can raise the original release's image quality.
primary.how_to_play: Play on GameCube/Wii hardware or Dolphin with a legally dumped disc and higher internal resolution.

all_releases.reason: primary: only official version and complete content.

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: GameCube emulation at high internal resolution

primary.why: Star Fox: Assault is a GameCube-exclusive rail/on-foot/vehicle combat entry with no port or enhanced edition; Dolphin is the highest-fidelity preservation route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on GameCube/Wii hardware or Dolphin with a legally dumped disc and higher internal resolution.

all_releases.reason: primary: only official platform and complete content.

emulation.notes: Touch-screen layout matters for the control scheme.

primary.why: Star Fox Command is a DS-exclusive tactical/space-combat entry with no port or enhanced edition, and the original hardware best matches its touch-screen controls.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Nintendo DS/3DS hardware or a legally dumped copy in melonDS.

all_releases.reason: primary: only official version and intended control format.

entries.title: Star Fox 64 3D

emulation.notes: 3DS emulation can increase internal resolution; hardware preserves stereoscopic 3D.

primary.why: Star Fox 64 3D is the 3DS remake of Star Fox 64 with updated graphics, stereoscopic 3D, gyro controls, and new voice recordings.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Nintendo 3DS hardware or a legally dumped copy in 3DS emulation.

all_releases.fidelity: 3DS remake with stereoscopic 3D and updated presentation.
all_releases.reason: primary: only release of this remake.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: This entry is specifically the 3DS remake.

entries.remaster_caveats: The upcoming Switch 2 Star Fox is a separate future remake/reboot entry.

entries.title: Star Fox Zero

emulation.notes: Cemu can improve output resolution, but the dual-screen control setup must be configured carefully.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Wii U / Cemu at higher resolution

primary.why: Star Fox Zero is a Wii U-exclusive reimagining with GamePad-based dual-screen controls and no port or enhanced edition.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Wii U hardware with the GamePad, or use Cemu with a legally dumped copy and a suitable dual-screen setup.

all_releases.reason: primary: only official platform and complete content.

entries.remaster_caveats: No Switch port; GamePad control is core to the original design.

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Wii U / Cemu at higher resolution

primary.why: Star Fox Guard is a Wii U-exclusive tower-defense/security-camera spinoff released alongside Star Fox Zero, with no later port.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Wii U hardware or Cemu with a legally dumped copy and configured GamePad display.

all_releases.reason: primary: only official platform and complete content.

entries.title: Star Fox 2

emulation.notes: SNES emulation is a fallback if not using the official release.

primary.version: Official released SNES ROM via current official emulation
primary.why: Star Fox 2 was completed in 1995 but officially released on the SNES Classic in 2017 and later added to Nintendo Switch Online, making Switch Online the current official route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Star Fox 2 through Nintendo Switch Online SNES, or on SNES Classic Edition.

all_releases.fidelity: First official release of the completed SNES game.
all_releases.reason: skip: historic first release, but Switch Online is the current official route.
primary: current official access to the completed game.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Switch Online provides the official completed ROM in a current service context.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is not a prototype recommendation; use Nintendo's official release.
